examples.arabic: قررت انو أحسن شي لهيك يوم هو اني كمل النسكافيه و اتفرج على فيلم
examples.english: I decided that the best thing for such a day is to finish the Nescafé and watch a movie
examples.transliteration: Qarrart inno aḥsan shī la-hēk yōm huwwe inni kammil in-neskāfē w atfarraj ʿala film

examples.arabic: امي حكت انها راحت على السوق مبارح لتشتري اغراض بينما اخوي حكى انه شاف فيلم حلو كتير
examples.english: My mother said she went to the market yesterday to buy groceries while my brother said he saw a very nice movie.
examples.transliteration: Immi ḥakat inna-ha raaḥat 3ala s-soo' imbareḥ la-tishtari aġraaḍ baynama akhūy ḥaka inno shāf film ḥelo kteer.
